title: Cohomology along an affine morphism: the edge map is an isomorphism
statement: Let $h:X\to S$ be an affine morphism of schemes [pqf-def-affine-morphism] (for instance a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]) and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Then $R^ph_*\mathcal F=0$ for $p>0$ [pqf-def-cohomology], and for every $p\ge0$ the edge map $e_{h,\mathcal F}:H^p(S,h_*\mathcal F)\to H^p(X,\mathcal F)$ of [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] (c) (the map induced by the $h$-map $\mathrm{id}_{h_*\mathcal F}$) is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_S(S)$-modules.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 089W (lemma-relative-affine-cohomology, line 202) and its proof: Lemma 01XC (lemma-relative-affine-vanishing, line 181) and the Leray spectral sequence, Cohomology, Lemma 01F4 (cohomology-lemma-apply-Leray) part (1), whose identification is the edge map of Equation 01FA; used in Lemma 02OD's proof ('By the Leray spectral sequence for i_n')
